title: Mille Feuilles PAGE NewsEye report version 1

const: Projection page-newseye-v1 of the canonical page; keep the canonical JSON to preserve non-projected data.
ReadingOrder lists TextRegions only; AdvertRegion, SeparatorRegion and GraphicRegion are unordered.
Each advertisement is a TextRegion followed by a sibling AdvertRegion with identical Coords; the pairing is geometric, not by identifier.
custom attributes use the profile grammar name {key:value;}; no JSON.
Articles are carried by structure {id:...; type:article;} on each TextLine only.
Coordinates are rounded with floor(v + 0.5) and clamped to the image; every Baseline point is kept.
Hyphenated words keep their visible hyphen; no reconstruction is projected.
imageFilename is a relative POSIX path; the bundle makes it resolvable.
Conventions of this profile only; no claim of compatibility with every NewsEye or Transkribus reader.
